Promotion stock stays offboard until a legal promotion.

concept.envelope_note: 56 mm is tallest on-board assembly height: board surface22 plus rook34. Camera itself is exactly196 by196 by26. Offboard loose-piece presentation arrays are excluded from this in-use camera envelope.
concept.interaction: Players use camera_board for standard chess, freely lift or slide white_king, white_queen, white_rook, white_bishop, white_knight, white_pawn, black_king, black_queen, black_rook, black_bishop, black_knight and black_pawn; remove captures and exchange promoted pawns for offboard replacement masks. No light or physical line-of-sight test is involved.
concept.print_stance: Each of97 items is individually monolithic and printed upright on a flat base;2 mm minimum structural features and at most45-degree unsupported overhangs.
risks: Camera recognition of the shallow broad lens needs actual rendered inspection.
Bishop and rook must remain distinct by peaked versus flat crest and26 versus34 mm height.
Printability, all97 inventory occurrences and exact signature geometry remain Manager verification tasks; no physical print or human playtest is claimed.
concept.signature_interaction: Fixed elevated h1 view shows White K a1,R h1,Black K a8 before; only rook translates140 mm to h8 after, giving check, fully visible above rim. All other pieces offboard.
concept.summary: Chess — coronagraph theme: rival optical masks cross a focal-plane board to leave the opposing star no safe line of sight.
concept.title: Limbward

design_changes.change: Grip relief uses three transverse upper channels; lens has shallow upper-deck engraving.
design_changes.reason: Maintain monolithic support-free mass and exact overall envelope.

design_changes.change: Elliptical lens recess slopes inward4 mm over2 mm depth.
design_changes.reason: Original ellipse taper failed overhang check; steeper wall passes.

design_changes.change: Pawn upper wedge10x8 mm, roof8–12 mm; bishop plateau3 mm; knight depth8 mm.
design_changes.reason: Blunt robust tips and wider foot margins preserve role silhouette and all Wish sizes after thickness feedback.

design_changes.previous: Single broad oval front recess and flush grip read as carry handle on tray in independent review 1.
design_changes.reason: Repair required camera recognition without changing chess, inventory or user dimensions.
design_changes.replacement: Concentric elliptical surround with circular solid optical centre, inner circular well, forward asymmetric grip and integrated shutter boss, all within 196 x 196 x 26 mm.

research.design_provenance: Dimensions and forms in handoff are deliberate design decisions within the sealed Wish, not borrowed source CAD.

queries: coronagraph chess optical mask chess set
novelty_search.result: No identical concept surfaced in bounded search. Limbward is an existing astronomical directional word. Closest known physical collisions are recorded above. Claim only an unusual original combination.

research.popularity_verdict: Pass: UN recognition evidence and independently Chess.com operating game-volume evidence establish broad international popularity.
research.public_domain_basis: Exact chess methods of play are implemented as public-domain/noncopyrightable mechanics, supported by USCO and WIPO; no claim that the modern FIDE publication is public-domain prose. All explanatory text and physical designs are original.

sources.claim: Primary exact standard-chess rules provenance; full equivalence ledger is authored in design-handoff.md.
sources.rights: Reference only; no prose, diagrams or icons copied.

sources.claim: UN describes worldwide recognition, International Chess Day and reports hundreds of millions of regular adult players.
Independent operating platform reports more than ten million chess games daily; supports active broad popularity.
USCO excludes game ideas and methods of play from copyright; expressive prose and artwork may be protected. Supports implementing chess mechanics with original expression.
WIPO distinguishes copyright expression from ideas, procedures and methods of operation. Mechanics basis does not license FIDE rulebook prose.
Coronagraph masks suppress stellar glare to reveal faint planets and debris. This motivates the metaphor, not movement laws or an optical simulation.
sources.rights: No instrument geometry or agency marks used.

sources.claim: Jim Podpolucha telescope-themed chess set is a close2012 collision; our pieces are optical masks rather than telescope models.
NASA-inspired chess uses planets and mission vehicles; Limbward uses one occultation metaphor without agency identity.
sources.rights: No downloadable geometry or artwork used.

sources.claim: Cosmos expresses astronomy through painted chess forms; Limbward uses original mask volumes and focal-plane camera form.

research.zero_difference_audit: No source setup, legal choice, information, probability, transition, result, scoring or named exceptional rule changes; original optical geometry is a bijective role/side/square representation. Authored audit only; no human playtest claim.
